attr.title: Zenmai
attr.desc: Zork I (1979), read and typed in Japanese - with a Japanese input method driven entirely by the gamepad. No keyboard, no system IME: hold a consonant row with the left hand, tap a vowel with the right, and the kana appears. English play is also included, typed with T9. Originally written for the PlayStation; this is the same C, with only the nine functions that touch the machine swapped out.
attr.inst: Install with PortMaster; extracting the zip by hand leaves the port out of the launcher's list. Nothing else is needed - the story file and the font are already inside.
